title: Large Chart AOD watch face no colour
symptom: The Large Chart watch face does not change between Always On Display and Active Display modes, making it hard to tell if the watch face is active. The user requests a low/no colour version for AOD with thinner line weights and less detail.
evidence_quote: There is currently no difference between the Always On Display and Active Display versions of the Big Chart watch face. Basically it's very hard to tell if the watch face is active or not.
